dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Tom, is your hometown very different from Bangkok?
dialogue.reading: ˈtɑːm, ɪz jʊr ˈhoʊmtaʊn ˈvɛri ˈdɪfərənt frəm ˈbæŋkɑːk?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes! Bangkok is much bigger. The population of my hometown is only about fifty thousand.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz ˈmʌtʃ ˈbɪɡər. ðə ˌpɑːpjəˈleɪʃən əv maɪ ˈhoʊmtaʊn ɪz ˈoʊnli əˈbaʊt ˈfɪfti ˈθaʊzənd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Wow, that's small! Is the air cleaner there?
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ, ðæts ˈsmɔːl! ɪz ði ˈɛr ˈkliːnər ˈðɛr?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Much cleaner. The pollution in Bangkok is far worse.
dialogue.reading: ˈmʌtʃ ˈkliːnər. ðə pəˈluːʃən ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz ˈfɑːr ˈwɜːrs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What about the cost of living?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈkɔːst əv ˈlɪvɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Bangkok is a bit cheaper. But my apartment here is much smaller. There isn't much space.
dialogue.reading: ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz ə ˈbɪt ˈtʃiːpər. bʌt maɪ əˈpɑːrtmənt ˈhɪr ɪz ˈmʌtʃ ˈsmɔːlər. ðɛr ˈɪzənt ˈmʌtʃ ˈspeɪs.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: A little. There's always a big crowd on the train in the morning.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɪtəl. ðɛrz ˈɔːlweɪz ə ˈbɪɡ ˈkraʊd ɑːn ðə ˈtreɪn ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: So which city do you like better?
dialogue.reading: soʊ ˈwɪtʃ ˈsɪti ˈduː juː ˈlaɪk ˈbɛtər?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Bangkok! It's a bit noisier, but it's much more interesting.
dialogue.reading: ˈbæŋkɑːk! ɪts ə ˈbɪt ˈnɔɪziər, bʌt ɪts ˈmʌtʃ ˈmɔːr ˈɪntrəstɪŋ.
